subject: GPU Safeguard & Hold Request — Kappa Enterprises (Final POC)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: soft GPU hold for Kappa final POC

Irene — quick heads up. Kappa (Anjali) just told us their legal/procurement loop will take ~10 business days, but the POC needs to run in early April for their internal demo calendar. They asked whether we can put a 2-week soft hold on capacity (they expect ~16 A100-equivalent GPUs at peak) while they finish PO/contract.

Details I have:
- POC period: target window 2028-04-08 -> 2028-04-15
- Estimated peak concurrent: 16 A100 or a mix of A10s + A100 q4 quantized profile
- Expected start hinge: once PO returns (they said they will push this week)

Can infra confirm whether we can place a soft hold (no billing until PO signed, but reserve capacity) and whether region preference (us-west) is possible? Ben, can you advise on runtimes/quantization tradeoff if they want to reduce GPUs?

This is late-stage — VP of Platform is on the thread if we need escalation. Would like a clear ask back to Anjali by EOD.

— Rishi

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: soft GPU hold for Kappa final POC

On Fri, Mar 2, 2028 at 09:12 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Irene — quick heads up. Kappa (Anjali) just told us their legal/procurement loop will take ~10 business days, but the POC needs to run in early April for their internal demo calendar. They asked whether we can put a 2-week soft hold on capacity (they expect ~16 A100-equivalent GPUs at peak) while they finish PO/contract.
> 
> Details I have:
> - POC period: target window 2028-04-08 -> 2028-04-15
> - Estimated peak concurrent: 16 A100 or a mix of A10s + A100 q4 quantized profile
> - Expected start hinge: once PO returns (they said they will push this week)

We can do a soft hold, but a few operational constraints:
- Currently we can earmark the equivalent of 16 A100s in us-west for a max 14-day soft hold; beyond that we need a reserved commitment.
- If they accept a mixed SKU approach (A10s + 8x A100 q4), we can push the effective GPU-hours down ~35% using RT batching + quantization profiles. That changes cost and latency SLAs; we should map that in the MAP.
- We require a placeholder PO or signed MSA addendum to stop the clock on the hold (legal needs a document to mark the reservation). If they share a PO draft, we can accept that as progress and set a conditional hold for up to 7 business days during procurement review.

Attached: capacity-runbook.md (runbook for placing soft holds + escalation matrix).

Operational ask to Irene: please authorize a 14-day soft hold for Kappa in us-west contingent on procurement submitting PO draft by 2028-03-08. If no draft by then, auto-release. I'll flag the nodes as "soft-hold:kappa-2028-04".

— Ben

From: Anjali Shah <anjali.shah@kappaent.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@kappaent.com
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GPU Safeguard & Hold Request — Kappa Enterprises (Final POC)

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick coordination. A few clarifications from our side: 
- We can provide a PO draft today (attached).
- Region preference: us-west preferred for our staging environment, but we can accept multi-region split if it reduces latency risk.
- Confirming target concurrency: 16 A100-equivalent peak, but we are open to a hybrid mix if you can share latency projections.

Can Redwood confirm whether the soft hold will be visible in the console (so our infra team can plan)? Also requesting a one-page runbook we can add to our internal checklist (who to ping if nodes fail during the POC).

We will aim to submit the PO draft and the procurement contact by COB today. Please let me know the next steps and any internal forms you need.

— Anjali

Attachment: Kappa-PO-draft.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anjali Shah <anjali.shah@kappaent.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GPU Safeguard & Hold Request — Kappa Enterprises (Final POC)

Anjali — thanks, and welcome.

Summary & next steps (action owner in parentheses):
1) Redwood will place a 14-day soft hold on 16 A100-equivalent capacity in us-west, conditional on receiving the PO draft by 2028-03-08. If Kappa submits the PO draft today, we will set the hold immediately (Ben).
2) Ben will post the capacity-runbook.md runbook into a shared Drive folder and make the hold visible in the Console under "Reserved > Soft Holds > kappa-2028-04" (Ben) — expected by EOD.
3) If Kappa agrees to a hybrid SKU to reduce unit cost, Ben will provide a 1-pager with latency vs cost tradeoffs and a recommended config (Ben) — due 2028-03-04.
4) Legal/procurement checkpoint: placeholder PO draft accepted for conditional hold; final signed PO required to convert to billed reserved capacity (Rishi + Laura to follow up on contracting).
5) Auto-release policy: hold releases automatically after 14 days if no signed PO; ops will notify both parties 48 hours prior to release (Ben).

Anjali — please confirm when procurement uploads the draft and whether us-west is confirmed. If you want the nodes split across us-west/us-east we can present a redundancy plan (note this may alter the node mix).

I'll keep the loop and convert to a HubSpot task after this thread.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
